tha-ap31:1.1: Ekañjalika.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ gacchantaṃ antarāpaṇe / Vipassi-satthavāhaggaṃ naravīraṃ vināyakaṃ // //
tha-ap31:2.1: Adantadamanaṃ tādiṃ mahāvādiṃ mahāmuniṃ / disvā pasanno sumano ekañjalim akās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap31:3.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe yam añjalim kariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi añjalissa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap31:4.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap31:5.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekañjaliko thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
